_comment: safety 大类自写批 · langwatch 正文英译（2026-11-06）。axes 八维、runs/unknowns 对应「官方口径与未核到项 / 未知项清单」；一句话定位与适合与不适合两节由 .md 正文渲染，related/sources 按索引对齐。

axes.model_access: The docs position it as an LLMOps platform that tracks "every LLM call, tool usage, and user interaction"; the models under test are yours to connect, the platform does not ship a model. The full compatibility list was not verified item by item on the check date.
axes.runtime: Two placements: the hosted product, or self-hosting the open-source core (the docs state the core is Apache-2.0 and self-hostable). Feature differences between hosted and self-hosted were not verified item by item.
axes.local_files: Self-hosting keeps traces in your own storage; on the hosted product trace data leaves your machine. Retention location and deletion terms were not verified for this entry.
axes.background: Tracing and evaluation run as a continuous service; the offline batch and scheduled-task surface was not verified item by item.
axes.tools: The official list of capabilities is tracing, evaluations, agent testing and prompt management; whether custom judges and external tools can be plugged in is not spelled out on the pages checked.
axes.context: Context length belongs to the application under test; platform-side limits on trace size, sampling and retention windows were not verified.
axes.permissions: The hosted product has an account and team permission model (tiering not verified); self-hosted, permissions equal whatever your deployment grants.
axes.fit: Fits: keeping live calls, evaluations and prompt versions in one place while retaining a self-hosting path. Does not fit: anyone wanting only a ready-made benchmark score, or anyone who cannot let trace data leave their environment and plans to use the hosted product.

runs: This entry has not completed measured runs on interception rates, evaluation consistency or performance. Capability wording comes from the official docs and changelog reachable on the check date; the site does not restate their figures as an evaluation, and draws no comparison against similar products.
unknowns:
- Feature delta between the hosted product and the self-hosted core
- Retention location, deletion deadlines and training use on the hosted plan
- Full list of supported models and frameworks
- Exact boundaries of custom judges and external tool integrations
- Trace size limits, sampling policy and retention window
- Account and team permission tiers on the hosted product
